==About==
I co-founded this wiki with [[User:nae'blis|nae'blis]] back in October 2005.  Regrettably I've not had much time to contribute in recent years due to work and other projects.

And as of October 2010 I ''haven't read The Gathering Storm yet!''

However I just got myself a kindle, which is simply awesome.  I'm picking up in ACOS where I last left off.  Within a couple months I'll get to read through TGS and Towers of Midnight back-to-back, both for the first time! So really you should envy me that :)

In other news, at the end of next year I can finally start reading 'A Song of Ice and Fire'.  I made a pact with myself, you see: I'm only allowed to start reading a single huge-yet-unfinished fantasy series at a time ;)
